title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: A struggling writer is hired to finish a bestselling author's series after an accident leaves the author unable to work. In the family home, she finds an unpublished autobiography and begins to doubt what's true.
readIf: you want a dark, compulsive psychological thriller with a shock or two and plenty of steam.
skipIf: you can't read about the death of children or want an unambiguous ending.

pairings.reason: Another thriller where the stories people write about themselves can't be trusted.
Another psychological thriller built on a hidden manuscript-like record and a final twist.
The classic of a newcomer in a house still ruled by another woman.
